Victoria Chen
Enterprise Sales Manager
New York, NY | victoria.chen@email.com | +1 555-013-5577 | linkedin.com/in/vchen-sales

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Results-driven B2B Enterprise Sales Manager with 8 years of experience scaling SaaS enterprise sales, pipeline management, account management, and team leadership. Consistently exceeded annual quotas (145% average attainment), delivering $4.2M+ in net-new ARR and closing 15+ six-figure deals.

WORK EXPERIENCE
Enterprise Sales Manager | CloudScale SaaS | New York, NY | 2021 - Present
- Achieved 145% quota attainment in 2023, generating $4.2M in annual recurring revenue (ARR) from Fortune 500 accounts.
- Expanded enterprise pipeline by 80% through strategic account management and lead generation initiatives in Salesforce CRM.
- Closed 15+ six-figure enterprise SaaS contracts with average deal size of $280K.
- Improved team deal win rate from 22% to 38% by introducing structured value-selling and contract negotiation frameworks.
- Led and coached a team of 6 Enterprise Account Executives and BDRs.

Senior Account Executive | SalesGrowth Tech | New York, NY | 2017 - 2021
- Outperformed sales quota for 12 consecutive quarters, earning President's Club recognition twice.
- Managed full sales cycle from initial cold outreach and discovery to executive demo, negotiation, and closing.
- Developed accurate revenue forecasting models for executive leadership.

EDUCATION
Bachelor of Science in Business Administration | Columbia University | 2013 - 2017

SKILLS & COMPETENCIES
- Sales Strategy: B2B Sales, Enterprise Sales, SaaS, Pipeline Management, Account Management, Lead Generation, Revenue Forecasting
- Execution & Tools: Salesforce CRM, Negotiation, Solution Selling, Contract Closing, Prospecting, Outreach.io, Gong, Hubspot
jobDescriptionText: Seeking a B2B Sales Manager / Enterprise Account Executive with 6-10 years experience in Enterprise Sales, SaaS, Salesforce CRM, Pipeline Management, Account Management, Negotiation, Forecasting, and Lead Generation. Proven track record of quota attainment and ARR expansion.
